args.author: agent:flying-mouse
args.body: asked for a patagium and a styliform cartilage, the ontology gives one and refuses the other: styliform cartilage is in the hierarchy, and patagium, wing are never_in_taxon Glires. A mouse may have the strut that tensions a flight membrane and may not have the membrane. That is the shape of the whole result: the skeleton of flight is permitted in this clade and the surface that would carry the air is not.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
